name: Pay 2 life for a shockland that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play Watery Grave from hand and pay the 2 life when doing so makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - Thoughtseize with nothing else up. A free untapped land always wins when one is available (this play's false repeats U's own key), and life stays unspent below 8: at 7 or less the 2 life is not worth a turn 1-2 card this early. Also stands down once a fetch in hand could reach a FREE BASIC unlock (unlocks_by_basic_search, not F's broader unlocks_by_search - a fetch that can only reach a non-basic unlock, a shockland the library holds but no basic, never makes this play stand down, since F itself would then pay the fetch's own life cost on top of the shock's; hand Strand+Watery Grave+Thoughtseize with only a library Watery Grave reachable is exactly that case - this play still pays for the hand Grave). Against boros-aggro, boros-energy and ur-cutter-prowess - the format's fast aggressive decks - paying 2 life on turn 1 or 2 is a real cost, so this play stands down entirely against them; open-fetch-unlocks-basic (never paying life) covers the same need there instead. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
